run_lsc_demo: run the LSC demo that takes voice instructions and executes pick and place tasks on Spot robot
run_main_function: run the main function that processes audio instructions and navigates robot to waypoints for object manipulation
use_whisper_translator: use WhisperTranslator to record audio and transcribe voice instructions to text for robot commands
use_rearrange_llm: use RearrangeEasyChain LLM to parse natural language instructions into navigation and pick targets
use_sentence_similarity: use SentenceSimilarity to find the most similar known waypoints from user-provided location names
